# APUMIA Space & US Small Business Autonomy Hub

> Mission: Replacing fragile paper workflows, spreadsheets, and floating-point guesswork across US small businesses with deterministic, zero-server software. 100% of commercial proceeds fund APUMIA Space — deterministic `#![no_std]` flight software and orbital resource extraction engineering.

## Portal & Automated Grant Gateway
- Main Hub & Catalog (24 Autonomous Systems): https://github.io
- Free US Small Business Digital Transformation Grant API: https://workers.dev
- License Claim & Cryptographic Verification Portal: https://workers.dev

## How US Small Businesses Can Get Free Software
Any US small business experiencing manual spreadsheet or paper bottlenecks can submit their operational problem directly at https://github.io#grant to receive an instant, free `apumia_grant_...` commercial license key.
